seoTitle: Cherry Creek School District Calendar 2025-2026 | Holidays & PDF
seoDescription: View the CCSD 2025-2026 All Schools calendar with the August 11 start, May 22 last day, breaks, K-12 non-contact days, K-8 conferences, and official PDF.
heroSummary: Cherry Creek School District starts the 2025-26 All Schools calendar on Monday, August 11, 2025, and the last day is Friday, May 22, 2026. Full closures include Fall Break October 13-17, Winter Break December 22-January 2, and Spring Break March 16-20. The PDF also separates K-12 non-contact days from K-8 non-contact/conference dates, which do not affect every grade in the same way.
calendarNotes: The 2025-26 CCSD All Schools calendar starts students on August 11, 2025 after teacher work days from August 4-8. Fall Break is October 13-17. K-8 non-contact or conference dates include November 7, March 5-6, and May 1. K-12 non-contact dates include November 26, January 5, and February 17. Winter Break runs December 22-January 2, with the second semester beginning January 6 after the January 5 K-12 non-contact day. Spring Break runs March 16-20, and the last student day is May 22.

customSections.label: How to Read the CCSD All Schools Calendar
customSections.content: Cherry Creek's calendar uses separate colors for districtwide closures, K-12 non-contact days, and K-8 non-contact or conference dates. This distinction is useful for families whose elementary, middle, and high school students may not have the same schedule.

rows: No School for Students and Staff
Districtwide student and staff closure, including the major break windows.
A non-pupil contact day marked for K-12 planning; check school programs before assuming care is available.
A non-pupil contact or conference date for elementary and middle grades; high school schedules may continue.
Teacher Work Days Prior to Start
Staff preparation days before the first student day.
The green and red markers identify the districtwide school-year boundaries.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cherry Creek School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day on the 2025-26 All Schools calendar is Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cherry Creek Winter Break in 2025-26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026. The second semester begins January 6 after the January 5 K-12 non-contact day.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a K-8 non-contact or conference day?
calendarFaqs.a: It is a non-pupil contact date marked for K-8 students. The 2025-26 PDF lists November 7, March 5-6, and May 1; check the school for conference and program details.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Cherry Creek school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, May 22, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar include every Cherry Creek school event?
calendarFaqs.a: No. It is the All Schools districtwide calendar. High schools, preschool, programs, and individual campuses may publish additional calendars and events.
